title: Cross-class progression integration tests
description: End-to-end progression tests spanning award -> eligibility -> guided level-up -> deterministic apply for representative classes (a martial class with no spellcasting and a full caster), in both XP and milestone modes, asserting auditable ledger state and exact mechanical deltas. Validates the epic as a whole.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests cover XP and milestone modes for at least one martial and one caster class end-to-end, asserting ledger auditability and exact HP/feature/spell-slot outcomes.
close_reason: Added cross-class XP/milestone progression integration tests for Fighter and Cleric; fixed surfaced subclass/progression resolver gaps so full-caster apply audits exact deltas.
